checks: The native tray grip explains that an unrecorded portion cannot be added, without changing the cook.
Picking up the packet from another tool enters weighing; carrying the unweighed packet to the pot adds no pasta and keeps the camera steady.
Direct packet pickup can pour into the scale without shifting controls mid-gesture; the temporary amount changes the recipe only when recorded.
The tray checks filled and boiling water before lifting, while keeping measured quantities and cooking time unchanged.
Changing the weighing preview blocks the tray handoff and keyboard navigation focuses the control that records the new portion.
Level carry and a tipped-but-cancelled tray return the full recorded portion, with no food, temperature or time changes.
The dry pasta tray rejects the sauce pan and sideways tipping.
The actual release position is checked so an old prepared tip cannot commit after the tray has moved away.
A completed 160 g native handoff empties the tray, applies the existing temperature drop once, records one action and restores its before/after observation on reload.
The ingredient guide opens the recorded tray handoff; its keyboard path opens and focuses the equivalent pot action and produces the same temperature comparison.
Real phone pickup, carry, tip and release conserves a recorded 170 g portion for 2 servings and keeps the camera and canvas steady.
Real phone pickup, carry, tip and release conserves a recorded 320 g portion for 4 servings and keeps the camera and canvas steady.
Touch cancellation, blur and an external burner action return held pasta without creating a transfer.
Changing the temporary scale amount or resizing cancels a loaded tray without changing the recorded portion.
Temperature feedback and its follow-up routes fit phone screens and pass desktop, phone and forced-color accessibility scans.
Finished and replay kitchens keep visual exploration available while native dry-pasta additions stay locked.
Graphics-context loss restores the held tray and leaves the existing keyboard pasta addition usable.

accessibility.name: Desktop pasta entry and temperature comparison
